name: Shivam Mishra
bio: Shivam leads BookMyShow's iOS team and is backed by 6 years of experience in Objective-C and Swift. He focuses on application architecture, and played a key role in the complete re-write of BookMyShow's app. His curiosity drives him to constantly learn and experiment, and he is currently dabbling in React Native. When he's not at his desk coding, he is busy organising & managing Swift Mumbai meet ups, winning hackathons, and reading about Indian mythology.
